title: Pool Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Pool Party," the Dunder Mifflin crew gathers at Robert's house for a poolside get-together before he sells the property. Jim plays a prank on Dwight by hiding his stapler inside a giant meatball, much to Stanley's amusement. Kevin suggests the pool party to cheer Robert up. Erin attempts to make Andy jealous by flirting with Dwight, leading to playful antics including a chicken fight in the pool between Erin and Dwight versus Andy and Jessica. Meanwhile, Kelly finds an engagement ring with a missing stone, sparking superstitious concerns. Throughout the party, relationships and tensions surface, including Dwight confirming Andy and Erin are over, and Robert encouraging guests to enjoy the wild evening. Several outcomes remain uncertain, such as the final results of the chicken fight and the future of Andy and Jessica's relationship.
